dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000srr2](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000srr2) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 118.545 depth occurred on Apr 21 2026 25km W of Ibarra. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 0.3666 longitude -78.3421. It impacted 360812 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
